entities.name: Nicolò Rusca
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolò Rusca was an Italian priest who served in the Diocese of Como. Rusca was arrested under false pretenses and was killed through the use of torture in 1618. He was recognized by the Roman Catholic Church as a martyr and was beatified in 2013.
